usefulness.rationale: The dossier correctly identifies Okonjo-Iweala (WTO head, former Nigerian finance minister, co-author with Julia Gillard) and all three claims are supported by the cited passage. However, it is extremely thin: no dates, no detail on her WTO tenure, finance ministry terms, World Bank career, or education, and it does not state what it does not know. A reader learns only the barest outline of who she is and could not meaningfully prepare for a meeting. No overclaims found in the dossier statements themselves; the listed unjustified conclusions (Twitter board, IDA funds) do not appear in the dossier.
